gpt.rationale: Mostly subtle and reserved—fear/surprise dominate appropriately and the small neutral/dry-happy beats fit her shy humor, though the repeated surprise is a bit blunt and a few happiness choices read slightly too open for such an introverted character.

claude.rationale: Sprites track the line emotions well (fear when late, surprise at the anomaly, shy happiness in the teasing moments), but the repeated overt 'fear' and 'surprise' read louder than this reserved, subtly-expressive character would, and softer cues for the quiet downcast lines are missing.
